description: A paid plan for practicing score calculation of winning hands and tenpai hands, and the 1 Kyu and Shodan mock exams, with no daily limit. Choose a 30-day pass or a lifetime purchase. No automatic renewal.

perks.title: What Pro gives you
perks.unlimitedTitle: Practice as much as you like
perks.unlimited: Unlimited scoring of winning hands and tenpai hands, and unlimited 1 Kyu and Shodan mock exams
perks.tools: Answer-time tracking and hand display options (tiles randomly upside down, unsorted hands)
perks.freeLimits: Free daily limits after logging in: scoring winning hands, {agari} questions a day / scoring tenpai hands, {tenpai} questions a day / 1 Kyu and Shodan mock exams, {exam} questions a day each

offers.title: Choose a plan
offers.shared: Both give the same Pro features. No automatic renewal. Prices are in Japanese yen (JPY).
offers.lifetimeScope: The lifetime purchase does not include features added in the future.

lifetime.title: Lifetime
lifetime.description: Pay once and use the features available at purchase with no expiry

offers.priceUnavailable: Please check the price on the checkout page

notes.title: Before you buy
notes.pass: When the 30-day pass expires, you go back to the free plan. You cannot buy more while it is active, but you can buy it again after it expires.
notes.snapshot: Your purchase covers the benefits shown when you started checkout. Even if the benefits change during checkout, what you buy stays the same.
notes.noRefund: Because this is digital content, purchases cannot be refunded.
notes.receipt: You pay on Stripe's checkout page, and your card details are not stored on this site. Stripe emails you the receipt.
notes.deletion: If you delete your account, your purchase records are deleted and no refund is given.
notes.tokushoho: For details, see the <link>Specified Commercial Transactions Act Disclosure</link>.
